name: Higher Education Student Dropout & Success
tagline: Predict 3-class undergraduate outcomes across demographic and socioeconomic attributes.
description:
Compiled at the Polytechnic Institute of Portalegre, Portugal (supported by the SATDAP public administration modernization grant) and published by Realinho, Machado, Baptista, and Martins (2022), this dataset tracks 4,424 undergraduates across 17 degree programs from enrollment through the end of their second semester. Each student is classified into three mutually exclusive outcomes at normal degree completion time: 'Graduate' (2,209), 'Dropout' (1,421), or 'Enrolled' (794).

Addressing the scarcity of human-centered multiclass benchmarks in algorithmic fairness research (Pagano et al., 2023), this dataset combines integer-coded administrative categories, disguised 'Unknown'/'(blank)' parental codes (34 and 99), macroeconomic context, and rich equity attributes—including gender, age, scholarship status, tuition debt, displacement, and educational special needs (disability status)—alongside a temporal distinction between enrollment-time features and 1st/2nd-semester grades.

targetCandidates.description: Predict student academic outcome at normal program duration ('Dropout', 'Enrolled', or 'Graduate').
Predict whether a student holds a need/merit scholarship (1 = Yes, 0 = No) from demographic and academic profile.

columns.name: Marital Status
columns.description: Legal civil marital status of the student at enrollment.

columns.name: Application mode
columns.description: Portuguese national higher-education admission contingent or special entry pathway code.

columns.name: Application order
columns.description: Student's ranked preference order for the degree program (0 = 1st choice through 9 = last choice).

columns.name: Course
columns.description: Official institutional code for the undergraduate degree program.

columns.name: Daytime/evening attendance
columns.description: Whether classes are attended during daytime or evening working-student hours.

columns.name: Previous qualification
columns.description: Highest educational qualification completed prior to higher-education enrollment (coded per national education scale).

columns.name: Previous qualification (grade)
columns.description: Prior secondary or post-secondary qualification grade on the Portuguese 0-200 admission scale.

columns.name: Nacionality
columns.description: Student citizenship code (spelled 'Nacionality' in upstream UCI schema; 1 = Portuguese [97.5%], other codes denote Lusophone, EU, and Latin American nationalities).

columns.name: Mother's qualification
columns.description: Mother's highest completed education code (code 34 denotes 'Unknown' in 130 rows).

columns.name: Father's qualification
columns.description: Father's highest completed education code (code 34 denotes 'Unknown' in 112 rows).

columns.name: Mother's occupation
columns.description: Mother's ISCO occupational category code (code 99 denotes blank/unrecorded in 17 rows).

columns.name: Father's occupation
columns.description: Father's ISCO occupational category code (code 99 denotes blank/unrecorded in 19 rows).

columns.name: Admission grade
columns.description: Weighted entrance score combining secondary GPA and national exam scores (0 to 200 scale).

columns.name: Displaced
columns.description: Whether the student had to relocate away from their permanent family residence to attend the institution.

columns.name: Educational special needs
columns.description: Indicator of registered disability or special educational accommodation status (only 51 students [1.15%], illustrating small-subgroup fairness auditing challenges).

columns.name: Debtor
columns.description: Socioeconomic vulnerability indicator of unpaid institutional debt (dropout rate is 62.0% among debtors vs. 28.3% among non-debtors).

columns.name: Tuition fees up to date
columns.description: Whether the student's current semester tuition payments are up to date.

columns.name: Gender
columns.description: Administrative binary gender record (graduation rate is 57.9% for women [0] vs. 35.2% for men [1]).

columns.name: Scholarship holder
columns.description: Whether the student receives social-action financial aid (SAS scholarship; graduation rate is 76.0% for holders vs. 41.3% for non-holders).

columns.name: Age at enrollment
columns.description: Student age in years upon initial program enrollment.

columns.name: International
columns.description: Whether the student enrolled under international student status.

columns.name: Curricular units 1st sem (credited)
columns.description: Number of course units credited via prior learning recognition in the 1st semester.

columns.name: Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)
columns.description: Number of course units enrolled in during the 1st semester.

columns.name: Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)
columns.description: Number of exam/assessment evaluations attempted in the 1st semester.

columns.name: Curricular units 1st sem (approved)
columns.description: Number of course units passed in the 1st semester.

columns.name: Curricular units 1st sem (grade)
columns.description: Mean grade across passed 1st-semester units (0-20 scale; 0 when zero units were passed).

columns.name: Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)
columns.description: Number of enrolled 1st-semester units where the student did not sit for assessment.

columns.name: Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)
columns.description: Number of course units credited in the 2nd semester.

columns.name: Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)
columns.description: Number of course units enrolled in during the 2nd semester.

columns.name: Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)
columns.description: Number of exam/assessment evaluations attempted in the 2nd semester.

columns.name: Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)
columns.description: Number of course units passed in the 2nd semester (strongest post-year-1 predictor of graduation).

columns.name: Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)
columns.description: Mean grade across passed 2nd-semester units (0-20 scale).

columns.name: Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)
columns.description: Number of enrolled 2nd-semester units where the student did not sit for assessment.

columns.name: Unemployment rate
columns.description: Portuguese national unemployment rate during the enrollment academic year.

columns.name: Inflation rate
columns.description: Portuguese consumer price inflation rate during the enrollment academic year.

columns.name: GDP
columns.description: Real national gross domestic product growth indicator during the enrollment academic year.

columns.name: Target
columns.description: Three-class student status recorded at the end of normal degree program duration.

warnings: Deploying dropout-risk models punitively (e.g., for admissions screening or financial-aid withdrawal) creates self-fulfilling prophecies against low-income debtors and male or older working students; ethical deployment is strictly limited to supportive tutoring outreach.
Students with 'Educational special needs' represent only 1.15% of records (n = 51), demonstrating why aggregate accuracy masks high-variance error rates on disabled minorities (Simson et al., 2024).
